release.change: New: Imagina Mail, a version of Thunderbird for Android 24.0 modified by Imagina (it is not the official app)
New: Sign in with Imagina, and your mailboxes set themselves up: no server, address or password to type
New: New mail arrives at once, warned by Imagina, with no permanent notification and no extra permission
Changed: Imagina's colours, icon and texts, in the light and the dark theme
Changed: There are no donation requests
Fixed: New mail stopped arriving at once after signing in, until the app was restarted
